notes: DECLARED ONLY: no router adapter serves this wire today (adapters is empty), so none of the mapping below is measured through this repository. The canonical paths are the Responses API event names, not a normalized contract this codebase has verified: text arrives as response.output_text.delta, reasoning as reasoning-summary item deltas (detailed reasoning items are NOT normalized and have no host chunk field), tool arguments as response.function_call_arguments.delta addressed by item_id/output_index, usage on response.completed, and the terminal state is response.status plus response.incomplete_details rather than a finish_reason string. There is no [DONE] sentinel. capabilities are protocol-family defaults from the public docs; cache (usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens), structuredOutput (text.format json_schema) and vision are not verified against any adapter here. Adding an adapter for this wire requires its own conformance fixture and a revision bump if the canonical fields change.
